significance: One of the largest and most visited temples in Goa and the family deity shrine of many Gaud Saraswat Brahmins; the linga was carried here from Kushasthali in 1560 to escape Portuguese conversions.
story: Shiva is said to have fled Kailash after losing at dice and to have taken the form of a tiger to frighten Parvati, whose cry of Mam Girisha became the name Manguesh.
